# CPython 3.14.6 headers

Unmodified public and CPython embedding headers from the official Windows
CPython 3.14.6 distribution. The PSF license and bundled notices are in LICENSE.txt.
Runtime dependencies are downloaded separately by Engine/Build/SetupPythonRuntime.ps1.
The engine resolves embedding functions dynamically; importing the Engine module
does not load Python or require a Python DLL beside the editor executable.
